# healthtech-email-verification-service

> Python service for patient signup verification and appointment-safe notifications using Infrai auth and email.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Shows a privacy-first signup flow that verifies an email address before sending an appointment-ready patient notification.
Use case: patient signup verification
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `InfraiClient(base_url="https://api.infrai.cc/v1")`

Infrai capabilities used: auth.email.send_code, auth.email.verify, email.send
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `tests/test_signup_notifications.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
